disclaimer: These are a small set of BUNDLED literature fixtures for offline demonstration. They are real, well-known publications used to illustrate provenance handling; the app does not claim to have retrieved their full text, and 'exact_sequence_available' reflects that abstracts/records are not full methods.

records.title: mRNA vaccines - a new era in vaccinology
records.finding: Reviews mRNA design elements: cap, 5'/3' UTRs, codon optimization, and poly(A) tail; notes element choice affects expression but is context-dependent.

records.title: An analysis of 5'-noncoding sequences from 699 vertebrate messenger RNAs
records.finding: Defines the optimal translation-initiation context (Kozak consensus) around the start codon.

records.title: Fusion protein linkers: property, design and functionality
records.finding: Catalogs flexible (GS) and rigid (EAAAK) linkers for fusion proteins and their effects on domain independence.

records.title: Modification of antigen-encoding RNA increases stability, translational efficacy, and T-cell stimulatory capacity of dendritic cells
records.finding: Longer poly(A) tails and specific 3' UTR arrangements increased mRNA stability and translation in dendritic cells.
